name: Traffic light (Go/No-Go)
description: Press as fast as possible for the "go" stimulus and hold back for the "stop" one. Trains inhibition, sustained attention and speed.
instructions:
Shapes will appear in the middle of the screen.
When you see the green circle 🟢 press the button as fast as you can.
When you see the red square 🟥 do NOT press.
You can also use the space bar.
instructionsKids:
You are a fisher! When you see the little fish 🐟 press the button straight away.
Watch out for the shark 🦈: when it comes, do NOT press!
